errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Manage your login details and security.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password you log in with.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.enabledDescription: Enabled — an authenticator app code is required to log in.
twoFactor.disabledDescription: Off — add an authenticator app for an extra step at login.
twoFactor.saveRecoveryCodesTitle: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe
twoFactor.saveRecoveryCodesDescription: Each one lets you log in once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.setupInstructions: Scan this with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently deletes your account, your collection, and your trade list. This can't be undone.
delete.currentPasswordLabel: Enter your current password to confirm

language.title: Language
language.description: Only English is available today — more languages can be added later.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Track your Pokémon TCG Pocket collection.
login.confirmEmailDescription: You need to confirm {email} before you can log in.
login.checkInbox: Check your inbox for the confirmation link.
login.enterRecoveryCode: Enter one of your recovery codes.
login.enterAuthenticatorCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

register.title: Create an account
register.closedDescription: New accounts aren't being accepted right now.
register.description: Start tracking your Pokémon TCG Pocket collection.
register.confirmEmailInstructions: Check your inbox for a link to confirm {email} before logging in.
register.genericError: Could not create your account. Please check your details.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.description: We'll email you a link to reset it.
forgotPassword.submittedMessage: If an account exists for {email}, check your inbox for a reset link.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.missingInfo: This reset link is missing information. Request a new one.
resetPassword.genericError: Could not reset your password. Please check your details.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your email
confirmEmail.confirmedDescription: You're all set — you can log in now.
confirmEmail.failedDescription: That confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
confirmEmail.resendSentMessage: If that email needs confirming, check your inbox for a new link.

allCards.title: All cards
allCards.subtitle: Search and filter across every set at once.
allCards.emptyState: {count} cards across every set. Search by name, number, attack or ability, or use the filters to browse them.

cardDetail.notFound: Card not found. It may not exist in the current card data.
cardDetail.noBattleDetails: Battle details aren't available for this card.
cardDetail.notTradableNotice: This card can't be traded, so it can't go on your want or offer list.

collection.title: Your sets
collection.subtitle: Pick a set to view and update the cards you own.

catalog.title: Card data
catalog.description: What the server uses to validate card IDs. The card art and details you see on the site come from the bundled dataset.

emailConfirmation.title: Email confirmation
emailConfirmation.requiredDescription: Required — new accounts must click a link in their email before they can log in.
emailConfirmation.offDescription: Off — new accounts can log in right away.
emailConfirmation.smtpWarning: No SMTP server is configured, so no confirmation email can actually send. Configured admin accounts are always exempt, so turning this on can't lock you out — but it will lock out everyone else until SMTP is set up.

images.title: Card images
images.description: By default, card art loads from GitHub in each visitor's browser. Download it to this server (roughly 135 MB) and the site serves its own images, so it no longer depends on GitHub for art.
images.noneStored: No images are stored on this server yet.
images.failedRetry: {failed} couldn't be downloaded. Run it again to retry just those.

registration.title: New registrations
registration.openDescription: Open — anyone can create an account.
registration.closedDescription: Closed — the sign-up page is disabled. Existing users can still log in.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.description: Admin tools for managing users and app data.
settingsPage.usersDescription: Manage roles, moderate public share links, or remove accounts. You can't change or delete your own account here.

filterBar.moveTypeTooltip: The energy types a card's attacks cost

serverUnreachable.title: Can't reach the server
serverUnreachable.description: Check your connection and try again. Your collection is stored on the server, so it will be there when you're back online.

shareCard.title: Share your trade list
shareCard.description: Anyone with the link can see what you want and what you're offering. They can't edit anything.

listPage.title: Trade list
listPage.subtitle: Cards you want, and cards you're willing to trade away.
listPage.emptyActiveCards: No cards here yet. Add some from a set's page.

sharedPage.notFound: This share link is invalid or no longer active.
sharedPage.title: {displayName}'s trade list
sharedPage.readOnlyNotice: Read-only — get in touch with {displayName} to arrange a trade.

cardData.title: Card data & images
cardData.beforeLink: Card names, rarities, set information, and card images shown on this site come from the community-maintained
cardData.afterLink: dataset, pinned to a fixed release. Card artwork ultimately originates from the official Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket app and belongs to its respective rights holders; it's used here for identification purposes only, alongside the collection tracking this app actually provides.

noWarranty.title: No warranty
noWarranty.description: This tool is provided "as is," with no guarantee that card data, rarities, or set completion figures are complete or error-free. If something looks wrong, it's a bug in this tracker or its data source, not an official record.

footer.contactNotice: Questions about a specific asset, or a rights holder who'd like something addressed? Open an issue on the project's repository.
